notes.title: Get out onto the water today with VR Regatta, full version out now! 🍾⛵🎆
notes.notes:
Great news, virtual sailing fans!

After more than a year in early access, [i]VR Regatta: The Sailing Game[/i] officially launches today. Get that champagne bottle ready to smash on the bow* because this baby is seaworthy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/7b89bdd87b460ada6ef9221ac2a1385a6f3efadd.png[/img]

notes.title: VR Regatta official v1.0 release coming in just two weeks!
notes.notes:
Hello fans of virtual sailing!

VR Regatta has been on a long journey, but we have a [b]big[/b] milestone coming up that we’re really excited to tell you about. The game’s early access period is about to come to an end, and we are about to officially release version 1.0 of [i]VR Regatta: The Sailing Game[/i]!

As early access players, you’ve been with us from the start. We can never thank you enough for your patience, enthusiasm, and feedback, and this game could never have been as good as it is without your help. On [b]January 30th[/b] for players on the eastern side of Atlantic, or January 31st on the western side, v1.0 of VR Regatta will be released and all you early access players will be able to update your copies. [i]But that’s not all![/i] No, we’re not giving you any steak knives, but v1.0 will add a wealth of new content, including a new training sailboat for beginners and veterans to enjoy, plus a whole new location to explore. The MarineVerse team

notes.title: A big year of VR Regatta is over, with huge news to come! 💨⛵
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there, digital sailors![/h1]

2017 is sailing into the sunset, bringing to an end our biggest year so far of appearances and demos for VR Regatta. We’ve had a very eventful twelve months, and 2018 is already shaping up to be even busier!

Here is just a sampling of the things we got up to during 2017:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/3e059f5c2def22650af78479f0ad6a94cd541b18.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] ⛵ MarineVerse was officially incorporated as a company in Australia.
[*] ⛵ We demoed VR Regatta several times in our hometown of Melbourne, including exhibiting at [url=http://blog.marineverse.com/vr/2017/02/10/marineverse-at-pausefest-2017.html]PauseFest[/url], an event dedicated to innovative technology and exciting startups, and giving racing fans a taste of sailing at the [url=http://blog.marineverse.com/vr/2017/03/31/promoting-sailing-during-gp.html]Australian Grand Prix[/url] in cooperation with Australian Sailing. We also showed it at the Melbourne Boat Show, the Royal Brighton Yacht Club, and more.
[*] ⛵ We travelled around the world to show off our game, including demonstrating it to experienced sailors at the [url=http://blog.marineverse.com/events/2017/04/17/singapore-yacht-show-2017.html]Singapore Yacht Show[/url] and [url=http://blog.marineverse.com/marketing/2017/05/03/differentiating-your-business-with-vr-sailing.html]partnering with M&G[/url] team to deliver a virtual sailing experience at a conference in Davos, Switzerland.
[*] ⛵ It gave us a great sense of validation to be awarded [url=https://www.film.vic.gov.au/news/funding-boost-powers-up-nine-local-game-developers]a production grant from Film Victoria[/url] to help us develop our game by hiring some talented new people.
[*] ⛵ An astonishing 4,000 virtual sailors in over 80 countries played VR Regatta in 2017.
[*] ⛵ We’re not quite done yet! VR Regatta will be showcase at the [url=https://www.volvooceanracemelbourne.com/timetable]Melbourne stopover of the Volvo Ocean Race[/url] on 28 December.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/596d198cba19d3461ccfdb1971454b1fb1720168.jpg[/img]


We already have big plans for 2018, mainly the official launch of the game in the first quarter of 2018. [b] Stay tuned for our release date![/b] After our great experience this year, we will also be returning to PauseFest 2018 to exhibit again.


Our sincere thanks go out to everyone who has played our game, given us feedback, reported a bug, or done anything else to help make VR Regatta: The Sailing Game even better. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/f83d30008c2f44fc24892f46b2f3055ad8a62424.jpg[/img]


It’s been an incredibly challenging and exhausting year with a lot of hard work and long hours of travelling, but it’s worth it to work on a project that we love so much. You can keep up with the latest by following us on Twitter or checking in on our blog.

What are you looking forward to in 2018?

[i]Greg on behalf MarineVerse Team[/i]
https://www.marineverse.com/

Just pushed an update to VR Regatta. On the surface, it may look like not much have changed (if you ignore those [b]new fancy water reflections[/b]), however quite a lot have changed under the cover.

This update upgrades game engine and some of the major components (for example the one responsible for water simulation) - so if you notice any problems, bugs or performance regression, please contact us support@marineverse.com 

Some of the changes in this version:

[list]
    [*] Experimental [b]wind sound[/b] depending on where the player is looking ( in Tutorial, Race and Long Race)
    [*] Option to [b]attach controller[/b] to Wheel and Tiller ( use grip button instead of trigger)
    [*] [b]Oculus: Using grip[/b] instead of trigger to grab things
    [*] Experimental game progression system ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135509758530163792/ )
    [*] Experimental Player's profile ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135510393195098530/ )
    [*] Performance optimisation: Single pass rendering 
[/list]

As always, looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback :-) ( please contact us via e-mail or comment here )


Best regards,
Greg on behalf of MarineVerse team.
